stops.note: the Twi word simply means "spider", first recorded around 1700-1710 as the name of the trickster figure
carried to the Caribbean with enslaved Akan people and kept as the name of the spider trickster in Jamaican and wider English folklore
stops.meaning: a cunning spider trickster figure of folktales

current_meaning: the cunning spider trickster of West African and Caribbean folktales, and by extension a name for such a trickster figure
